content.text: LIC's Jeevan Labh (Plan No. 836) is a limited premium paying, non-linked, with-profits Endowment Plan. It offers a combination of protection and savings, providing financial support for the family in case of the unfortunate death of the policyholder any time before maturity and a lump sum amount at the time of maturity for the surviving policyholder.

items: Limited Premium Payment: Pay premiums for a shorter duration than the policy term.
Protection + Savings: Provides both a death benefit and a maturity benefit.
Bonus Facility: Participates in the profits of LIC and is eligible for Simple Reversionary Bonuses and Final Additional Bonus.
Loan Facility: A loan can be availed under the policy after payment of premiums for at least 2 full years.

sections.title: How Premiums and Benefits are Calculated

content.text: The calculator estimates your premium based on your age, the sum assured you choose, and the policy term. The maturity benefit is an estimation based on historical bonus rates declared by LIC. It is not guaranteed.
Maturity Benefit ≈ Sum Assured + Vested Simple Reversionary Bonuses + Final Additional Bonus (FAB)
